You live with your partner in a terraced house in Penrith, and your days are full with work, dinners, and some evenings out with friends.

topic: Is the Cat Bells walk in the Lake District open all year, and how long does the main route take?

text: Is cat bells open all year? And roughly how long does the main route take 🤔
Open access, so no closures as such. Can get icy on the top in winter though, bring spikes if it's been frosty
Hawes End up and back maybe 2.5-3 hrs at a steady pace. Longer if you go round via the ridge
👍 might do sat then. Weather looks wet tho
2-3 hrs is about right tbh 🏔️ ridge is 🔥 if u get a clear day
Will check the forecast tmrw and see 🤞
